page.overview:
Who is Hampton?

Hampton was an InGen security officer in San Diego.

Peter Ludlow instructed Hampton to admit Ian Malcolm and Sarah Harding to the InGen docks after Jerry denied them entrance. Following the crash of the S.S. Venture and the escape of the Tyrannosaur Buck, it was Hampton who explained to Ian and Sarah what had happened following the ship's departure from Isla Sorna, involving the crew administering amphetamines to the dinosaur after it went into arrest.

Hampton himself never appears in LEGO Jurassic World but numerous InGen guards are modeled on his appearance.
